item_name: Rothco Vintage Canvas Paratrooper Bag with Bio-Hazard Symbol
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Canvas Bio-Hazard Bag. Featuring a high-impact "Bio-Hazard" symbol on the front flap, this bag blends rugged style with everyday functionality. The spacious interior offers 3 inner compartments to organize your essentials, plus an outer snap-closure pocket for quick-access items. Built from durable vintage canvas and sized at 15" x 11" x 4", it’s the perfect companion for school, travel, or casual everyday carry. Adjustable shoulder straps ensure a comfortable fit wherever the day takes you.
